product_summary: Sponsorship intelligence platform tracking brand-property deals across sports, entertainment and media, with pricing benchmarks, activation creative library, audience insights and AI proposal evaluation for brands, rights holders, agencies and media companies.
current_data_sources: On-premise venue audits by a global scout team (venues, signage, assets)
In-media device scraping for sponsorship and advertising data (TV/streaming/audio)
Third-party individual profiles for demographic and affinity data
Transaction/deal data used to train pricing estimates ($45B+)
Sponsorship creative library and human-enriched deal records

api_or_integration_evidence.quote: Our global scout team and proprietary tech capture real-time sponsor activity—deal by deal, asset by asset.
Devices scraped for sponsorship & advertising data.

newsletter_capability_detail: Searched sponsorunited.com, /platform, /contact and the podcast-network insight page for newsletter and email sponsorship coverage. Their documented capture methods are venue audits, device scraping, profile data and deal transactions - none of which read newsletter issues. Newsletters appear only as their own marketing newsletter signup, and podcast networks appear as a customer segment rather than tracked inventory.
verified_gap: Newsletter sponsor and brand relationships are outside their documented capture stack (venue audits, device scraping, profiles, deal benchmarks). Their media coverage is device-scraped broadcast/streaming/audio, so email newsletter sponsorships - read from article text rather than a device - are the missing surface.

evidence.quote: Our global scout team and proprietary tech capture real-time sponsor activity—deal by deal, asset by asset.
Venues audited by 3,000 scouts, capturing offline data.
Devices scraped for sponsorship & advertising data.
Benchmark pricing and validate spend with $45B+ in verified deal data.
Sponsorship intelligence—demographics, engagement levels, listener behavior data, and more—is critical

likely_buyer_role: VP of Data / Head of Product or Chief Revenue Officer (dataset expansion and media-company segment)

contact_route.note: Contact form only ('Fill out this form to contact us and one of our team members will be in touch'); no public email or named data contact found.

caveats: Highest overlap risk of the batch: they sell sponsorship intelligence to the same brand and media-company buyers, so NF could be seen as a competitor or as a cheap data feed. Their $45B deal benchmark and activation library are far deeper on sports/entertainment; newsletters are a thin slice of their market. Positive signal is that podcast networks are already a served segment, suggesting appetite for creator-media sponsorship data.
